message.content:
**Traffic Laws & Regulations in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • High‑way/Interstate: 70–75 mph (some rural stretches up to 80)
• Urban roads: 25–45 mph depending on zone
• School zones: 20 mph during school hours unless posted otherwise
• Construction sites: Posted signs may lower limits temporarily | | **Seat Belt Law** | • All drivers and front‑seat passengers *must* wear seat belts.
• Rear‑seat adults also required if a lap belt exists.
• Failure → $50 fine + possible demerit points. | | **Cell Phone / Texting Rules** | • Hands‑free devices allowed only when operating the vehicle.
• Texting, emailing, or using handheld phones while driving is prohibited (no “hands‑free” exception).
• Violation carries a $200 fine plus 1 point. | | **Alcohol & Drugs** | • Legal Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC): 0.08% for >21 yrs old.
• Zero‑tolerance for under‑age (<21) drivers (any detectable alcohol).
• Penalties range from fines ($500+), license suspension, to jail time based on severity. | | **DUI Penalties** | • First offense: Up to 90 days imprisonment, $2,000 fine, 12‑month license revocation.
• Repeat offenses increase both prison terms and fines. | | **Headlights & Visibility** | • Use dipped headlights between sunset/sunrise and whenever visibility ≤ 300 ft.
• Fog lights permitted only in fog conditions. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, vehicles approaching first have priority.
• Pedestrians always yield where crosswalks exist.
• Emergency vehicles: pull over as soon as safe. | | **Lane Usage** | • Left lane primarily for passing; keep right except when overtaking.
• No left turns across opposing traffic lanes without a dedicated turn lane. | | **Overtaking Restrictions** | • Do NOT pass on curves, hills, or through intersections.
• Passing on the shoulder is illegal. | | **Parking Rules** | • No parking within 30 ft of fire hydrants, railroad crossings, or intersection corners.
• Street cleaning schedules posted locally—parking banned during those times. | | **School Bus Stop Sign** | • Stop before entering the bus’s stopping area until children board/alight.
• Failing to stop can result in a $250 fine and 5 points. | | **Reckless Driving** | • Defined as willful disregard of safety; includes speeding, tailgating, erratic weaving.
• Penalty: up to 180 days jail, $10k fine, license revocation. | --- ### How Enforcement Works | Agency | Typical Responsibilities | |--------|--------------------------| | **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** | Issuance of licenses, registration, and administrative penalties. | | **State Police / Highway Patrol** | Statewide highway patrol, investigations into serious violations. | | **Local Police / Sheriff's Office** | City streets, municipal ordinances, routine traffic stops. | | **County Road Departments** | Maintenance of county roads, signage compliance. | --- ### Where to Find Official Sources | Resource | Link | |-----------|------| | Texas Transportation Code (Title 7) | https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/?link=07 | | TxDOT Traffic Safety Information | https://www.txdot.gov/motorist-information.html | | TxDMV Driver Handbook | https://www.dmv.state.tx.us/documents/TXDriverHandbook.pdf | | Texas Penal Code (for DUI & reckless driving) | https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/?link=PEN | *(Links lead to current statutes and guidelines; check them regularly for updates.)* --- #### Practical Tips for Drivers 1. **Always Keep Your License & Registration Visible** – Required by law and handy for inspections. 2. **Check Local Ordinances** – Some cities impose stricter speed limits or additional parking bans. 3. **Plan Ahead During Peak Hours** – Avoid congested routes to reduce risk of speeding or aggressive maneuvers. 4. **Stay Informed About Construction Zones** – Follow detour signs; speeds often drop significantly. Feel free to let me know if you need deeper dives into any specific rule set (e.g., commercial driver requirements, toll road policies, or recent legislative changes)!
